Name: Harbor basin surge and emergency valve dispatch
Description: Real rain accumulation causes the harbor basin water level to rise rapidly from 40 cm to 110 cm. The telemetry is authentic.
Expected: Twin: PRT-WLV-01 reports the authentic 110.0 cm value (actual_value == reported_value). The runner records a PENDING marker before dispatch; the real ActuatorEngine advances RUNNING to COMPLETED and returns an effect that this runner does not apply to city_core.
Expected: Guardian: The scenario adapter validates the matching actual/reported values and returns TRUSTED.
Expected: Brain: Confirms TRUSTED, recognizes the flood threshold breach, and dispatches START to the linked port pump PRT-PMP-01.
How to verify: Follow the correlation_id through the reading, TRUSTED verdict, OPEN_DISCHARGE decision, and actuator RUNNING/COMPLETED events in logs/scn-02-*.log. The runner uses the Twin actuator engine; Guardian and Brain are explicit scenario adapters.
